records.name: Madhya Pradesh
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which found no Madhya Pradesh-specific trans statute or enforcement series and records it among the states/UTs that have not constituted the mandated transgender welfare board; with national legal uniformity (no state criminalisation) the deviation was not material enough to score separately (±0.02), so it is assessed at the national score.

records.name: Goa
records.summary:
The country dossier found no divergent Goan trans statute or enforcement pattern: the national framework alone defines Goa's legal position. In March 2026 that framework narrowed sharply — both houses removed the 2014 self-identification right, restricted legal recognition to traditional-community and intersex categories with mandatory medical certification, and added a coercion offence carrying up to life imprisonment, drawing a withdrawal request from a court-appointed advisory panel, protests after the vote, and warnings of exclusion from named trans activists; presidential assent was pending.

Neither the human-rights nor broadcast reporting on the change records any Goan ordinance, welfare-board action or incident series deviating in either direction: recognition machinery, certification boards and the new offence operate in Goa exactly as in every other state and territory, and that uniformity is the whole of the documented local picture.

records.name: Chandīgarh
records.summary: This union territory was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. Its one unit-level signal is official-will positive: Chandīgarh is among only 12 of India's 36 states/UTs that have constituted the transgender welfare board required by the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Rules, 2020 — though an RTI investigation found most such boards rudderless, without a policy framework, compliance mechanism or real power.

records.name: Jammu and Kashmīr
records.summary: No region-specific trans law or enforcement series was located in the research pass; the unit's distinction is structural rather than legislative. In 2019 the former state was reconstituted as a union territory governed by an appointed Administrator without a legislature, and armed-forces jurisdiction under AFSPA persists in parts — a heavy checkpoint-and-document regime that raises appearance-and-identity scrutiny for every traveller, and therefore specifically for anyone whose documents and presentation differ.
